# SkyUsdsArk

## SkyUsdsArk
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/arks/SkyUsdsArk.sol)

**Inherits:**
[Ark](../ark.md)

**Title:**
SkyUsdsArk

Ark that swaps the fleet asset to USDS via the Lite PSM and stakes
the USDS in the sUSDS (stakedUSDS) ERC4626 vault for yield


### State Variables
#### TO_18_DECIMALS_CONVERSION_FACTOR
Factor scaling the fleet asset's amount up to USDS's 18 decimals


```solidity
uint256 public immutable TO_18_DECIMALS_CONVERSION_FACTOR
```


#### litePsm
The LitePSM contract for fleet asset -> USDS swaps


```solidity
ILitePSM public immutable litePsm
```


#### usds
The USDS token contract


```solidity
IERC20 public immutable usds
```


#### stakedUsds
The stakedUSDS vault contract


```solidity
IERC4626 public immutable stakedUsds
```


### Functions
#### constructor


```solidity
constructor(address _litePsm, address _usds, address _stakedUsds, ArkParams memory _params) Ark(_params);
```

#### totalAssets


```solidity
function totalAssets() public view override returns (uint256 assets);
```

#### _withdrawableTotalAssets

Internal function to get the total assets that are withdrawable

Caps the withdrawable amount by stakedUsds.maxWithdraw() (the sUSDS
vault's reported limit), converted back to the fleet asset's
decimals. It does NOT additionally account for available LitePSM
buyGem liquidity, so a withdrawal can still fail at the PSM step if
the PSM lacks gem liquidity.


```solidity
function _withdrawableTotalAssets() internal view override returns (uint256 withdrawableAssets);
```

#### _board

Swaps the fleet asset to USDS via the Lite PSM and deposits the USDS into sUSDS


```solidity
function _board(uint256 amount, bytes calldata) internal override;
```

#### _disembark

Withdraws USDS from sUSDS and swaps it back to the fleet asset via the Lite PSM


```solidity
function _disembark(uint256 amount, bytes calldata) internal override;
```

#### _validateBoardData

Validates the board data (no-op; this Ark requires no board data)


```solidity
function _validateBoardData(bytes calldata) internal pure override;
```

#### _validateDisembarkData

Validates the disembark data (no-op; this Ark requires no disembark data)


```solidity
function _validateDisembarkData(bytes calldata) internal pure override;
```

#### _harvest

No-op harvest: yield is auto-compounded inside the sUSDS vault, so no rewards are claimed


```solidity
function _harvest(bytes calldata)
    internal
    pure
    override
    returns (address[] memory rewardTokens, uint256[] memory rewardAmounts);
```



## ILitePSM
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/arks/SkyUsdsArk.sol)

**Title:**
ILitePSM

Minimal interface for the Maker/Sky Lite Peg Stability Module used to
swap between the gem (the Ark's fleet asset, e.g. USDC) and USDS


### Functions
#### sellGem

Sells gem to the PSM in exchange for USDS


```solidity
function sellGem(address usr, uint256 gemAmt) external returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`usr`|`address`|Recipient of the USDS|
|`gemAmt`|`uint256`|Amount of gem (fleet asset) to sell|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The amount of USDS received|


#### buyGem

Buys gem from the PSM in exchange for USDS


```solidity
function buyGem(address usr, uint256 gemAmt) external returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`usr`|`address`|Recipient of the gem|
|`gemAmt`|`uint256`|Amount of gem (fleet asset) to buy|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The amount of USDS paid|


#### to18ConversionFactor

Returns the factor that scales the gem's amount up to 18 decimals


```solidity
function to18ConversionFactor() external view returns (uint256);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The 18-decimal conversion factor|
